exposure: severe thrombocytopenia (platelet count categories: 0-30 x 10^9/L and 30-50 x 10^9/L)
cohort: A total of 195 pregnant women with platelet counts below 50 x 10^9/L, admitted to a tertiary university hospital, were included in the study.
finding: Pregnant women with severe thrombocytopenia (platelet count <30 x 10^9/L) have an increased risk of preterm birth before 34 weeks and neonatal intensive care unit admission.
